results.title: couple prompt
results.prompt_text:
A romantic golden-hour couple portrait at a rocky seaside cliff during sunset. The couple stands close together facing each other at a slight angle, both turned toward one another and smiling warmly, as if sharing a joyful, intimate moment.

- The woman stands on the left, slightly shorter, looking up at the man with a bright smile, one hand gently resting on his chest.
- The man stands on the right, looking down toward the woman with a warm, affectionate smile, one hand casually tucked into his trouser pocket.
- Their bodies are angled toward each other, shoulders close, heads tilted slightly inward, creating an intimate, candid connection.
- Both are standing upright, relaxed posture, weight shifted slightly onto one leg each.

- Woman: a flowing dusty-rose/blush pink saree with gold embroidered border, delicate gold jewelry (layered necklace, chandbali/jhumka earrings), colorful stacked bangles on the wrist resting on his chest, soft wavy open hair.

- Location: rugged coastal rocks beside the ocean, soft waves in the background.
- Lighting: warm golden-hour backlight/rim lighting, soft hazy glow, sun flare in the background, pastel sky gradient (soft peach, cream, light blue).
- Extra elements: a few birds flying in the distant sky, red rose petals gently falling/floating around the couple for a dreamy, cinematic effect.

- Shot from a slightly lower angle, medium-close framing from the waist up.
- Shallow depth of field with a softly blurred background (rocks and sea out of focus).
- Warm, romantic color grading — soft contrast, warm highlights, cinematic wedding-photography style.
- Portrait orientation, high resolution, natural skin tones, soft directional light on faces.

Style: professional pre-wedding/engagement photography, candid emotional moment, warm cinematic tone, shallow depth of field, soft golden bokeh.

- Overall feel: high-quality digital pixel illustration, like a polished pixel-art 
  character portrait, not a low-res retro game sprite

Keep everything else (pose, outfit, accessories, setting) identical to the uploaded photo — 
only change the rendering style to this pixel art look.
